title: Choose the exact coaching composition
question: The visual world is locked. Which responsive composition should become the build contract?

options.label: Balanced Split
options.thesis: Offer and coach own the opening; proof arrives immediately beneath them.
options.viewport: A fluid two-column hero gives equal authority to the offer and Aljohn, followed by a wide proof row inside the first viewport.
options.risk: The clearest and calmest composition, but the proof is one reading beat later.

options.label: Proof First
options.thesis: L.A.’s transformation earns the promise before the visitor reaches the second fold.
options.viewport: A fluid 38/62 split keeps the offer and booking action on the left while the playable case study dominates the right.
options.risk: Aljohn’s authority is deliberately quieter so the evidence can lead.

options.label: Coach First
options.thesis: Aljohn, the plan, and the evidence share one editorial stage before a decisive booking rail.
options.viewport: A full-width title opens into a fluid 34/28/38 stage: coach portrait, coaching plan, and proof video side by side.
options.risk: The information density is highest and needs the most disciplined mobile reflow.
